watch.summary: The creator admits that watching esports pros gives him the delusional urge to play, naively believing he will somehow aim like them.

beats.what: Creator explains why he hates watching pros.
He describes how watching pros makes him want to immediately jump into a game.
He laughs at his foolish logic that he will somehow have aim like the pros.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Just maybe if I get in my game, I also will have aim like that.
watch.why: It captures a very relatable gamer experience where watching professional gameplay tricks your brain into thinking you can play just as well. It relies on casual self-deprecation and lighthearted commentary rather than a big punchline.
